name: Copper
one_liner: Copper provides a REST API for CRM user records and account management authenticated via API keys or OAuth 2.0.
access_note: API keys can be generated directly by users/admins in Copper system settings. OAuth 2.0 app registration requires contacting Copper support.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.
To generate an API token, in the Copper web app go to System settings > API Keys and click the 'GENERATE API KEY' button.
Although it's entirely feasible to implement the OAuth 2.0 flow through plain REST
